designationHistory.indexText: The U.S. Navy transferred Seal Island, a former bombing target off Vinalhaven, Maine, to the Fish and Wildlife Service in 1972 to become Seal Island National Wildlife Refuge.

authority.citation: Wildlife Order 96, under 16 U.S.C. 667b (transfer of surplus federal property for wildlife)
